basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Seattle, Washington, who recently got into building custom PCs. I spend my free time gaming and exploring new technology trends. I work as a junior software developer at a local startup. Typically online during evenings and weekends as I balance work and my passion for tech. I'm single, and my love for gaming often means late-night gaming sessions with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of technology and gaming, mostly acquired through self-teaching and online tutorials. As a junior developer, I am constantly learning and integrating new skills into my daily work. My interest in custom PCs stems from my gaming hobby.
